```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
Data used: Number of mpox cases in England by month
```{r}
mpoxdata<-read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(mpoxdata))
```

Plotting the data
```{r}

ggplot(mpoxdata, aes(
  x = date,
  y = `Clade IIb`,
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Number of Cases") +
  ggtitle("Number of mpox Clade IIb cases over time")
```
